events.title: August 2026 market refresh completed
events.detail: The candidate catalog was expanded and corrected, a new dated Japanese price snapshot was added, and unverifiable Chinese checkout prices were intentionally left missing.

events.title: AMD added Radeon RX 9050 support in Adrenalin 26.7.1
events.detail: The product is now tracked as a new entry-level market signal, but retail specifications and pricing remain insufficiently verified for a purchase recommendation.

events.title: Yen volatility increased after intervention-related moves
events.detail: The yen moved sharply around reported intervention activity, reinforcing the need to preserve the exact observation time for every JPY/CNY conversion instead of treating one monthly rate as timeless.

events.title: AMD launched Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Dual Edition
events.detail: The dual-cache flagship is now included as a high-end simulation and creator reference, not as the default value recommendation.

events.title: Intel Core Ultra 200S Plus desktop processors became available
events.detail: Core Ultra 7 270K Plus and Core Ultra 5 250K Plus are now active comparison points for total platform cost and productivity performance.

events.title: AMD expanded Ryzen AI 400 to desktop OEM systems
events.detail: Track whether retail DIY variants or compelling small-form-factor systems alter the desktop-versus-laptop decision.
